request.description:
Upserts marks into the session by playerId (merge semantics, not full replace).

Only the marks sent in the body are affected. Existing marks for other players are preserved.
Sending a mark for a player that already exists updates their status/timestamp.

To remove a player mark, use DELETE /attendance/sessions/:category/:date/marks/:playerId.
